text:
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades , Downgrades & Initiations
$AAPL, $IAC, $XOM, $HPQ, $TGT
Daily HeffX -LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid.
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Thursday, as follows:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was upgraded to Buy from Hold at Maxim Group. The 52-wk trading range is 142.20 – 190.37. The consensus price target is set at 197.02.
IAC/InterActive Corp. (NASDAQ:IAC) analysts started with a Buy rating and a 183 price objective at Deutsche Bank. That compares with a consensus target of 189.35 and a 52-wk trading range of 98.27 – 166.64.
Exxon Mobil Corp. (NYSE:XOM) was raised to Outperform from Sector Perform at RBC Capital Markets. The 52-wk trading range is 72.16 – 89.30. The consensus price target is set at 87.26.
HP Inc. (NYSE:HPQ) was raised to Buy from Hold at Maxim Group after posting Solid Quarterly results. The 52-wk trading range is 17.10 – 24.75, and the posted consensus price objective is 25.76.
Target Corp. (NYSE:TGT) was added to the Merrill Lynch US 1 stock list. The firm has an 86 price target on the retail leader, while the consensus target was last seen at 76.91.
Stay tuned…
